assumptions_not_known: does not accept high accuracy scores at face value
searches for data leakage, calibration mismatches, and synthetic distribution shortcuts
evaluates ML rigor against real-world production distribution shift

criteria.name: metrics honesty
criteria.evidence: backend/app/services/ml_metrics.py: Metrics calculated over 15,240-sample 5-fold cross-validation with exact per-class confusion matrix (23/25 cells populated) and support counts.
criteria.quote: Honest metrics exposition with explicit Macro-OvR multi-class ROC-AUC and support breakdowns.

criteria.name: leakage risk
criteria.evidence: Feature extraction separates header parsing from model scoring; external feed features could exhibit minor temporal survival bias.
criteria.quote: Low data leakage risk; dataset split uses 5-fold cross-validation on normalized email records.

criteria.name: calibration integrity
criteria.evidence: Expected Calibration Error (ECE) of 0.018 and 10-bin calibration curve with empirical accuracy tracking predicted probabilities.
criteria.quote: Well-calibrated probability outputs avoiding overconfident extreme predictions.

criteria.name: feature engineering soundness
criteria.evidence: 47 features balance domain intelligence, structural links, RFC auth failures, and linguistic urgency.
criteria.quote: Sound multi-modal feature engineering combining deterministic protocol signals with NLP.

criteria.name: adversarial-robustness evidence
criteria.evidence: Unicode normalization and homoglyph mapping neutralize zero-width spaces, Cyrillic spoofing, and RTLO tricks (verified in test_model_metrics.py).
criteria.quote: Adversarial evasion defenses actively tested against Unicode obfuscation.

top_finding: Linguistic urgency feature relies on keyword/regex weighting; fine-tuning a small offline transformer (DistilBERT) on genuine BEC datasets will improve semantic nuance.
unanswered_question: How does the model perform on multilingual spear-phishing written in non-Latin scripts (e.g. Hindi, Russian, Arabic)?
